```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 9)
```

# What this does

The original analysis drew a PCA for every model it fitted, with a 95% ellipse around each
treatment: each stressor against its control, every arm of a tissue, both tissues together,
and the same sets with the day-0 lab control (`01_code/_superseded/02_5_DESeq_*`). Step 03
kept four of them. This step draws every one of those sample sets again, the same way, and
compares them:

- **Each sample set on its own.** A blind variance-stabilising transform of the set's
  libraries (`DESeq2::vst(blind = TRUE)`; Anders and Huber 2010, *Genome Biol* 11:R106; Love,
  Huber and Anders 2014, *Genome Biol* 15:550), nuclear genes only (step 01's mitochondrial
  loci left out, as in the DESeq2 fits), and a principal component analysis of the `ntop` (500)
  genes with the largest variance in that set, exactly as `DESeq2::plotPCA` does (a check
  compares the scores). Each set has its own transform and components, so axes are not
  comparable between sets, except within the figure of both tissues, which is one PCA.
- **Ellipses.** 95% for each group, from a multivariate t distribution fitted to its points
  (`ggplot2::stat_ellipse`, type "t", which uses `MASS::cov.trob`; Venables and Ripley 2002,
  *Modern Applied Statistics with S*, 4th ed.), as the original figures drew them.
- **What drives each component.** The 25 genes with the largest loadings on PC1 and PC2 of each
  set, with the protein name of their best hit in the annotation of record (`03_blast` step 05's
  `LOC_GO_list.txt`, highest bitscore), and the share of each component's squared loadings on
  genes named as byssal proteins (foot, adhesive plaque, byssal, precollagen, thread matrix,
  YGH-rich and collagen-like proteins and the three *M. coruscus* byssus proteins `09` step 04
  counts as byssal accessory; the loadings of a component square-sum to 1).
- **The comparison.** How much of the variation the groups explain: PERMANOVA on the Euclidean
  distances between the libraries in the same `ntop` genes, and in all genes (R², pseudo-F and a
  permutation p from `nperm` label permutations; Anderson 2001, *Austral Ecology* 26:32-46). A
  difference in spread between groups also raises PERMANOVA's R², so each set also gets the
  distance of each library to its group's centroid, compared between groups by ANOVA (the
  centroid form of PERMDISP; Anderson 2006, *Biometrics* 62:245-253). Both give the statistics of
  `vegan::adonis2` and `vegan::betadisper(type = "centroid")` exactly (checked on 2026-10-17 on
  five of the sets with vegan 2.7.6); they are computed here so that the pipeline does not need
  vegan.
- **RNA isolation day.** RNA was isolated arm by arm (step 01's `library_crosswalk.csv`, from the
  isolation log): in foot each arm on its own day (the controls on 2021-12-23, with the day-0
  animals; DO, OA and OW on 2022-01-09, -10 and -11), so a foot contrast cannot be told apart from
  a difference between isolation days. In gill the controls and DO share a day and OA and OW each
  span two, so the isolation day can be tested within arms there: the same PERMANOVA for the day
  within each arm, after the arm, with the days permuted among the libraries of each arm. In foot
  only an indirect check is possible: the three stressor contrasts compare each arm with the same
  controls, so a difference between the controls' isolation day and the others' would be shared by
  all three, as genes DE in all three contrasts in the same direction and as agreement between
  their fold changes (step 04's apeglm tables). Gill, whose controls share their day with DO, is
  the comparison; a shared reference also makes the fold changes agree a little by itself, in
  both tissues.

**The lab control** (the twelve day-0 animals) is not a control anywhere in the analysis: their
feet were dissected differently (two pieces at day 0, one at day 3) and they were sampled three
days earlier, so a difference between them and the day-3 animals cannot be put down to the
laboratory or to the exposure. The versions with the lab control show where those animals fall.
Foot panels use their phenol-gland-to-tip libraries, the region of every day-3 foot library; the
libraries of the rest of the foot appear only in the figure of every library.

**Sample sets**, each tissue on its own, without and with the lab control:

1. every day-3 arm (control, OA, OW, DO);
2. each stressor with the day-3 controls (the samples of the contrasts of record, step 02), the
   same with the lab control added, and the lab control against the day-3 controls;
3. both tissues in one PCA, each tissue drawn in its own panel on the same axes;
4. every library, by sampled region.

Writes, in `03_analyses/pca/`: `PCA_arms.png`, `PCA_pairwise_foot.png`, `PCA_pairwise_gill.png`,
`PCA_both_tissues.png`, `PCA_all_samples.png`, `PCA_comparison.png`, `PCA_comparison.csv` (one row
per sample set: groups, variance of PC1 and PC2, the byssal share of each, PERMANOVA in the top
genes and in all genes, the spread test), `PCA_loadings.csv` (the 25 genes with the largest
loadings on PC1 and PC2 of each set), `PCA_scores.csv` (PC1 and PC2 of every library in every
set, with its RNA isolation date), `PCA_isolation_day.csv` (the isolation day within arms) and
`isolation_day_contrasts.csv` (what the three stressor contrasts of each tissue share).

```{r paths}
source(here::here("01_code", "_paths.R"))
source(file.path(repo_root, "tools", "plot_style.R"))
source(file.path(repo_root, "tools", "pipeline_checks.R"))   # warn_unless()
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(DESeq2); library(ggplot2); library(patchwork) })
NTOP <- params$ntop; NPERM <- params$nperm; SEED <- params$seed
pca_dir <- here::here("03_analyses", "pca")
dir.create(pca_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

gcm <- as.matrix(read.csv(file.path(cnt, "gene_count_matrix_clean.csv"), row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE))
mtl <- read.csv(file.path(cnt, "mitochondrial_loci.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
stopifnot(all(mtl$gene %in% rownames(gcm)))
gcm <- gcm[!rownames(gcm) %in% mtl$gene, ]                 # nuclear genes only
ti  <- read.csv(file.path(cnt, "treatmentinfo_clean.csv"), row.names = 1, colClasses = "character")
cs  <- read.csv(file.path(deg, "contrast_samples.csv"), colClasses = "character")
cw  <- read.csv(file.path(cnt, "library_crosswalk.csv"), colClasses = "character")
ti$isolation_date <- cw$isolation_date[match(rownames(ti), cw$sample.1)]
warn_unless(all(rownames(ti) %in% colnames(gcm)), "A library of the sample table is missing from the count matrix.")
warn_unless(!anyNA(ti$isolation_date) && all(ti$isolation_date != ""), "A library has no RNA isolation date in the crosswalk.")
cat("nuclear genes:", nrow(gcm), "| libraries:", nrow(ti), "\n")

## protein name of each gene's best hit (highest bitscore, ties in table order), joined by gene_key()
source(file.path(repo_root, "tools", "gene_ids.R"))
ann <- read.delim(file.path(blast_go, "LOC_GO_list.txt"), sep = "\t", header = TRUE)[, c("gene", "Protein.names", "bitscore")]
ann <- ann[!is.na(ann$gene) & ann$gene != "", ]
ann <- ann[order(ann$gene, -ann$bitscore, seq_len(nrow(ann))), ]
ann <- ann[!duplicated(ann$gene), ]
## names of byssal proteins: 09 step 04's byssal structural and accessory names, and the collagen-like
## proteins of the M. coruscus byssus proteome
BYSSAL_RX <- paste("foot protein", "adhesive plaque", "polyphenolic", "byssal", "byssus", "\\bmefp", "precollagen",
                   "preCol", "thread matrix protein", "YGH-rich protein", "collagen-like protein",
                   "protease inhibitor-like protein-1", "C1q-domain-containing protein-1",
                   "TSP_1 domain containing protein-1", sep = "|")

## group of each library: its arm at day 3, "LC" for the day-0 lab control
ti$group <- ifelse(ti$day == "0", "LC", ti$treatment)
GROUPS <- c("LC", names(TREATMENT_COLORS))
GROUP_COLORS <- c(LC = THREAD_TRT_COLORS[["lab_control"]], TREATMENT_COLORS)
GROUP_SHAPES <- c(LC = 21, control = 21, OA = 22, OW = 24, DO = 23)   # filled shapes; LC and control differ by fill and ellipse line
GROUP_LABELS <- c(LC = "Lab control (day 0)", control = "Control (day 3)", OA = "OA", OW = "OW", DO = "DO")
TISSUES <- c(F = "Foot", G = "Gill")
```

# The sample sets

```{r sets}
lab_control <- function(t) rownames(ti)[ti$tissue == t & ti$day == "0" & ti$region != "foot (without phenol gland)"]
day3 <- function(t, arms = names(TREATMENT_COLORS)) rownames(ti)[ti$tissue == t & ti$day == "3" & ti$treatment %in% arms]
sets <- list()
add_set <- function(tissue, comparison, lc, samples)
  sets[[length(sets) + 1]] <<- list(tissue = tissue, comparison = comparison, lab_control = lc, samples = samples)
for (t in names(TISSUES)) {
  add_set(t, "every arm", FALSE, day3(t))
  add_set(t, "every arm", TRUE, c(day3(t), lab_control(t)))
  for (s in c("OA", "OW", "DO")) {
    smp <- cs$sample.1[cs$code == sprintf("%s%s_TC", t, s)]
    stopifnot("contrast samples differ from the sample table" = setequal(smp, day3(t, c("control", s))))
    add_set(t, sprintf("%s vs control", s), FALSE, smp)
    add_set(t, sprintf("%s vs control", s), TRUE, c(smp, lab_control(t)))
  }
  add_set(t, "lab control vs control", TRUE, c(day3(t, "control"), lab_control(t)))
}
add_set("F+G", "both tissues", FALSE, c(day3("F"), day3("G")))
add_set("F+G", "both tissues", TRUE, c(day3("F"), day3("G"), lab_control("F"), lab_control("G")))
for (i in seq_along(sets)) sets[[i]]$id <- sprintf("%s | %s%s", sets[[i]]$tissue, sets[[i]]$comparison,
                                                  if (sets[[i]]$lab_control) " | with lab control" else "")
n_min <- min(unlist(lapply(sets, function(s) table(paste(ti[s$samples, "tissue"], ti[s$samples, "group"])))))
warn_unless(n_min >= 3, "A group has fewer than 3 libraries in some sample set (an ellipse needs at least 3).")
knitr::kable(data.frame(set = vapply(sets, `[[`, "", "id"),
                        libraries = vapply(sets, function(s) length(s$samples), 0L)))
```

# PCA, PERMANOVA and spread of each set

```{r compute}
pca_of <- function(samples) {
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(gcm[, samples], ti[samples, c("tissue", "treatment", "day")], ~ 1)
  v <- assay(vst(dds, blind = TRUE))
  rv <- apply(v, 1, var)
  top <- order(rv, decreasing = TRUE)[seq_len(min(NTOP, length(rv)))]   # as DESeq2::plotPCA
  pc <- prcomp(t(v[top, ]))
  rot <- pc$rotation[, 1:2]; rownames(rot) <- gene_key(rownames(v)[top])
  list(scores = pc$x[, 1:2], var = pc$sdev^2 / sum(pc$sdev^2), v = v, top = top, rot = rot)
}
byssal_share <- function(rot, k) {
  nm <- ann$Protein.names[match(rownames(rot), ann$gene)]
  sum(rot[grepl(BYSSAL_RX, nm, ignore.case = TRUE, perl = TRUE), k]^2)
}
## PERMANOVA from squared Euclidean distances (Anderson 2001): SS_total = sum_{i<j} d2 / n and
## SS_within = sum over groups of sum_{i<j in group} d2 / n_group
perm_stats <- function(D2, g) {
  n <- length(g); k <- nlevels(g); sst <- sum(D2[upper.tri(D2)]) / n
  ssw <- sum(vapply(levels(g), function(l) { i <- which(g == l); sum(D2[i, i][upper.tri(D2[i, i])]) / length(i) }, 0))
  c(R2 = (sst - ssw) / sst, F = ((sst - ssw) / (k - 1)) / (ssw / (n - k)))
}
permanova <- function(X, g, seed) {
  g <- droplevels(factor(g)); D2 <- as.matrix(dist(X))^2
  obs <- perm_stats(D2, g)
  set.seed(seed)
  Fp <- vapply(seq_len(NPERM), function(b) perm_stats(D2, g[sample.int(length(g))])[["F"]], 0)
  c(obs, p = (1 + sum(Fp >= obs[["F"]])) / (1 + NPERM))
}
## spread: distance of each library to its group's centroid, ANOVA between groups (PERMDISP, centroid form)
spread <- function(X, g) {
  g <- droplevels(factor(g))
  d <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(X)), function(i) sqrt(sum((X[i, ] - colMeans(X[g == g[i], , drop = FALSE]))^2)), 0)
  a <- anova(lm(d ~ g))
  c(F = a$`F value`[1], p = a$`Pr(>F)`[1])
}
## groups for the statistics: the arm (or LC); in the set of both tissues, tissue and arm
group_of <- function(s) if (s$tissue == "F+G") paste(ti[s$samples, "tissue"], ti[s$samples, "group"]) else ti[s$samples, "group"]

res <- lapply(seq_along(sets), function(i) {
  s <- sets[[i]]; p <- pca_of(s$samples); g <- group_of(s)
  top <- permanova(t(p$v[p$top, ]), g, SEED + i)
  all <- permanova(t(p$v), g, SEED + 1000 + i)
  sp  <- spread(t(p$v[p$top, ]), g)
  list(pca = p, stats = data.frame(
    set = s$id, tissue = s$tissue, comparison = s$comparison, lab_control = s$lab_control,
    groups = paste(sprintf("%s %d", names(table(g)), as.integer(table(g))), collapse = "; "),
    libraries = length(s$samples), ntop = length(p$top),
    pc1_pct = round(100 * p$var[1], 1), pc2_pct = round(100 * p$var[2], 1),
    pc1_byssal_share = round(byssal_share(p$rot, 1), 3), pc2_byssal_share = round(byssal_share(p$rot, 2), 3),
    permanova_R2 = top[["R2"]], permanova_F = top[["F"]], permanova_p = top[["p"]],
    permanova_R2_all_genes = all[["R2"]], permanova_p_all_genes = all[["p"]],
    spread_F = sp[["F"]], spread_p = sp[["p"]], stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
})
cmp <- do.call(rbind, lapply(res, `[[`, "stats"))

## check: the scores are DESeq2::plotPCA's (up to the sign of each component)
chk <- function(i) {
  s <- sets[[i]]; dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(gcm[, s$samples], ti[s$samples, c("tissue", "treatment", "day")], ~ 1)
  d <- plotPCA(vst(dds, blind = TRUE), intgroup = "tissue", ntop = NTOP, returnData = TRUE)
  max(abs(abs(as.matrix(d[s$samples, c("PC1", "PC2")])) - abs(res[[i]]$pca$scores[s$samples, ])))
}
warn_unless(max(vapply(c(1, length(sets)), chk, 0)) < 1e-8, "PCA scores differ from DESeq2::plotPCA's.")
warn_unless(all(cmp$permanova_R2 > 0 & cmp$permanova_R2 < 1 & cmp$permanova_p > 0 & cmp$permanova_p <= 1),
            "A PERMANOVA statistic is out of range.")
knitr::kable(transform(cmp[, c("set", "groups", "pc1_pct", "pc2_pct", "pc1_byssal_share", "permanova_R2", "permanova_p",
                               "permanova_R2_all_genes", "permanova_p_all_genes", "spread_p")],
                       permanova_R2 = round(permanova_R2, 3), permanova_R2_all_genes = round(permanova_R2_all_genes, 3),
                       spread_p = signif(spread_p, 2)), row.names = FALSE)
```

# RNA isolation day

```{r isolation-day}
d3 <- ti[ti$day == "3", ]
knitr::kable(as.data.frame.matrix(table(paste(TISSUES[d3$tissue], d3$isolation_date), d3$group)[, names(TREATMENT_COLORS)]))
## the day within arms, after the arm (sequential sums of squares, Anderson 2001), the days permuted among
## the libraries of each arm; with SS_total and SS_arm fixed by that permutation, R2 orders as pseudo-F does
day_within_arm <- function(X, arm, day, seed) {
  D2 <- as.matrix(dist(X))^2
  ss_in <- function(g) sum(vapply(unique(g), function(l) { i <- which(g == l)
    if (length(i) < 2) 0 else sum(D2[i, i][upper.tri(D2[i, i])]) / length(i) }, 0))
  sst <- sum(D2[upper.tri(D2)]) / length(arm); ss_arm <- ss_in(arm)
  r2 <- function(d) (ss_arm - ss_in(paste(arm, d))) / sst
  set.seed(seed)
  null <- replicate(NPERM, { d <- day; for (a in unique(arm)) { i <- which(arm == a); d[i] <- d[i][sample.int(length(i))] }; r2(d) })
  c(R2 = r2(day), p = (1 + sum(null >= r2(day))) / (1 + NPERM), null_median = median(null))
}
iso <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(TISSUES), function(t) {
  i <- which(vapply(sets, function(s) s$tissue == t && s$comparison == "every arm" && !s$lab_control, TRUE))
  smp <- sets[[i]]$samples; arm <- ti[smp, "group"]; day <- ti[smp, "isolation_date"]
  split_arms <- names(which(tapply(day, arm, function(x) length(unique(x))) > 1))
  per_arm <- paste(sprintf("%s %s", names(TREATMENT_COLORS),
                           vapply(names(TREATMENT_COLORS), function(a) paste(sort(unique(day[arm == a])), collapse = "+"), "")), collapse = "; ")
  do.call(rbind, lapply(c("top", "all"), function(w) {
    v <- res[[i]]$pca$v; X <- t(if (w == "top") v[res[[i]]$pca$top, ] else v)
    st <- if (length(split_arms)) day_within_arm(X, arm, day, SEED + 2000 + 10 * match(t, names(TISSUES)) + (w == "all")) else c(R2 = NA, p = NA, null_median = NA)
    data.frame(tissue = t, genes = if (w == "top") sprintf("%d most variable", NTOP) else "all", isolation_days = per_arm,
               arms_with_two_days = if (length(split_arms)) paste(split_arms, collapse = ", ") else "none: each arm isolated on one day, not testable",
               R2_day_within_arm = st[["R2"]], p = st[["p"]], null_median = st[["null_median"]], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
}))
knitr::kable(transform(iso, R2_day_within_arm = round(R2_day_within_arm, 3), null_median = round(null_median, 3)), row.names = FALSE)

## what the three stressor contrasts of a tissue share (step 04's apeglm tables; tested genes: padj not missing)
shared <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(TISSUES), function(t) {
  tab <- lapply(setNames(nm = c("OA", "OW", "DO")), function(x) {
    d <- read.csv(file.path(deg, TISSUES[[t]], sprintf("%s%s_TC_apeglm.csv", t, x)))
    d[!is.na(d$padj), c("gene", "log2FoldChange", "padj")] })
  g <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(tab, `[[`, "gene"))
  L <- sapply(tab, function(d) d$log2FoldChange[match(g, d$gene)])
  de <- sapply(tab, function(d) d$padj[match(g, d$gene)] < 0.05)
  all3 <- rowSums(de) == 3; r <- cor(L)
  ctl_day <- unique(ti$isolation_date[ti$tissue == t & ti$day == "3" & ti$treatment == "control"])
  data.frame(tissue = t, controls_isolated = paste(ctl_day, collapse = "+"),
             controls_share_day_with = (function(x) if (length(x)) paste(x, collapse = ", ") else "none")(
               setdiff(unique(ti$group[ti$tissue == t & ti$day == "3" & ti$isolation_date %in% ctl_day]), "control")),
             DEGs_OA = sum(tab$OA$padj < 0.05), DEGs_OW = sum(tab$OW$padj < 0.05), DEGs_DO = sum(tab$DO$padj < 0.05),
             genes_tested_in_all_three = length(g),
             DE_in_all_three = sum(all3), same_direction = sum(all3 & abs(rowSums(sign(L))) == 3),
             r_lfc_OA_OW = r["OA", "OW"], r_lfc_OA_DO = r["OA", "DO"], r_lfc_OW_DO = r["OW", "DO"], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
knitr::kable(transform(shared, r_lfc_OA_OW = round(r_lfc_OA_OW, 2), r_lfc_OA_DO = round(r_lfc_OA_DO, 2), r_lfc_OW_DO = round(r_lfc_OW_DO, 2)), row.names = FALSE)
```

# Figures

```{r figures}
fmt_p <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.001, "< 0.001", formatC(p, format = "fg", digits = 2))
stats_line <- function(st) sprintf("PERMANOVA R2 %.2f, p %s; spread p %s", st$permanova_R2, fmt_p(st$permanova_p), fmt_p(st$spread_p))
scales_groups <- list(
  scale_fill_manual(values = GROUP_COLORS, labels = GROUP_LABELS, limits = GROUPS, drop = FALSE, name = NULL),
  scale_colour_manual(values = GROUP_COLORS, labels = GROUP_LABELS, limits = GROUPS, drop = FALSE, name = NULL),
  scale_shape_manual(values = GROUP_SHAPES, labels = GROUP_LABELS, limits = GROUPS, drop = FALSE, name = NULL),
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(LC = "dashed", control = "solid", OA = "solid", OW = "solid", DO = "solid"),
                        limits = GROUPS, guide = "none"))
pca_panel <- function(i, title, facet = FALSE) {
  r <- res[[i]]; s <- sets[[i]]
  d <- data.frame(r$pca$scores, sample = s$samples, tissue = TISSUES[ti[s$samples, "tissue"]],
                  group = factor(ti[s$samples, "group"], levels = GROUPS))
  g <- ggplot(d, aes(PC1, PC2)) +
    ## show.legend = TRUE: every panel draws a key for every group, so the collected legends are
    ## identical and merge into one (by default a panel draws keys only for the groups it holds)
    stat_ellipse(aes(fill = group, colour = group, linetype = group), geom = "polygon", type = "t",
                 level = 0.95, alpha = 0.12, linewidth = 0.45, show.legend = TRUE) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = group, shape = group), colour = "grey15", size = 2.1, stroke = 0.3, show.legend = TRUE) +
    scales_groups +
    labs(x = sprintf("PC1 (%.0f%%)", 100 * r$pca$var[1]), y = sprintf("PC2 (%.0f%%)", 100 * r$pca$var[2]),
         title = title, subtitle = stats_line(r$stats)) +
    theme_psmfc(9) + theme(aspect.ratio = 1, plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9.5),
                           plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7.5), legend.position = "bottom")
  if (facet) g + facet_wrap(~ tissue, scales = "free") + theme(aspect.ratio = 1) else g   # one PCA, each tissue zoomed to its own range
}
which_set <- function(tissue, comparison, lc) which(vapply(sets, function(s) s$tissue == tissue && s$comparison == comparison && s$lab_control == lc, TRUE))
save_fig <- function(p, name, w, h) { ggsave(file.path(pca_dir, name), p, width = w, height = h, dpi = 220, bg = "white"); print(p) }
caption <- paste0("Each panel is its own PCA: blind VST of its libraries, the ", NTOP, " genes with the largest variance; ellipses 95% (multivariate t).",
                  "\nPERMANOVA: Euclidean distances in the same genes, ", NPERM, " permutations; spread: distance to the group centroid, ANOVA. Axes not to scale.")

## 1. every arm, each tissue on its own, without and with the lab control
p1 <- (pca_panel(which_set("F", "every arm", FALSE), "Foot, day 3") | pca_panel(which_set("G", "every arm", FALSE), "Gill, day 3")) /
      (pca_panel(which_set("F", "every arm", TRUE), "Foot, day 3 and lab control") | pca_panel(which_set("G", "every arm", TRUE), "Gill, day 3 and lab control")) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") + plot_annotation(title = "Every arm, without (top) and with (bottom) the lab control", caption = caption) &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
save_fig(p1, "PCA_arms.png", 9, 10)

## 2. each stressor against the day-3 controls, without and with the lab control, one figure per tissue
for (t in names(TISSUES)) {
  top <- lapply(c("OA", "OW", "DO"), function(x) pca_panel(which_set(t, paste(x, "vs control"), FALSE), sprintf("%s vs control", x)))
  bot <- lapply(c("OA", "OW", "DO"), function(x) pca_panel(which_set(t, paste(x, "vs control"), TRUE), sprintf("%s vs control, with lab control", x)))
  lc  <- pca_panel(which_set(t, "lab control vs control", TRUE), "Lab control vs control")
  p2 <- (wrap_plots(c(top, list(plot_spacer())), nrow = 1) / wrap_plots(c(bot, list(lc)), nrow = 1)) +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
    plot_annotation(title = sprintf("%s: each stressor against the day-3 controls (the samples of the contrasts of record), without (top) and with (bottom) the lab control", TISSUES[[t]]),
                    caption = caption) & theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  save_fig(p2, sprintf("PCA_pairwise_%s.png", tolower(TISSUES[[t]])), 15, 8.6)
}

## 3. both tissues in one PCA, each tissue in its own panel on the same axes
p3 <- pca_panel(which_set("F+G", "both tissues", FALSE), "Foot and gill, day 3: one PCA", facet = TRUE) /
      pca_panel(which_set("F+G", "both tissues", TRUE), "Foot and gill, day 3 and lab control: one PCA", facet = TRUE) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(title = "Both tissues in one PCA (tissue is PC1), each tissue in its own panel, zoomed to its own range",
                  caption = sub("Each panel is its own PCA", "Each row is one PCA of both tissues", caption)) &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
save_fig(p3, "PCA_both_tissues.png", 9, 10)

## 4. every library, by sampled region
pa <- pca_of(rownames(ti))
da <- data.frame(pa$scores, region = factor(ti$region, levels = names(REGION_COLORS)), day = factor(paste("day", ti$day)))
p4 <- ggplot(da, aes(PC1, PC2)) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(fill = region, colour = region), geom = "polygon", type = "t", level = 0.95, alpha = 0.10, linewidth = 0.45) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = region, shape = day), size = 2.2, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = REGION_COLORS, labels = REGION_LABELS, name = NULL) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = REGION_COLORS, labels = REGION_LABELS, guide = "none") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("day 0" = 1, "day 3" = 16), name = NULL) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(order = 1), shape = guide_legend(order = 2)) +
  labs(x = sprintf("PC1 (%.0f%%)", 100 * pa$var[1]), y = sprintf("PC2 (%.0f%%)", 100 * pa$var[2]),
       title = "Every library, by sampled region", caption = sub("Each panel is its own PCA", "One PCA of every library", caption)) +
  theme_psmfc(10) + theme(aspect.ratio = 1, legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "vertical")
save_fig(p4, "PCA_all_samples.png", 7.5, 8)

## 5. the comparison: how much the groups explain in each set, in the 500 most variable genes and in all genes
long <- rbind(data.frame(cmp, genes = sprintf("%d most variable genes", NTOP), R2 = cmp$permanova_R2, p = cmp$permanova_p),
              data.frame(cmp, genes = "all genes", R2 = cmp$permanova_R2_all_genes, p = cmp$permanova_p_all_genes))
long$genes <- factor(long$genes, levels = c(sprintf("%d most variable genes", NTOP), "all genes"))
long$panel <- factor(c(F = "Foot", G = "Gill", "F+G" = "Both tissues")[long$tissue], levels = c("Foot", "Gill", "Both tissues"))
long$row <- factor(long$comparison, levels = rev(c("every arm", "OA vs control", "OW vs control", "DO vs control",
                                                  "lab control vs control", "both tissues")))
long$version <- factor(ifelse(long$lab_control, "with lab control", "without lab control"), levels = c("without lab control", "with lab control"))
p5 <- ggplot(long, aes(R2, row)) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = version, fill = p < 0.05), size = 2.8, colour = "grey15", stroke = 0.4,
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = fmt_p(p), group = version), size = 2.4, hjust = -0.35, colour = "grey30",
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  facet_grid(genes ~ panel, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("without lab control" = 21, "with lab control" = 22), name = NULL) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "grey20", `FALSE` = "white"), labels = c(`TRUE` = "p < 0.05", `FALSE` = "p >= 0.05"), name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.3))) +
  guides(shape = guide_legend(order = 1), fill = guide_legend(order = 2, override.aes = list(shape = 21))) +
  labs(x = "Share of the variation the groups explain (PERMANOVA R2); label: permutation p", y = NULL,
       title = "Every PCA sample set compared",
       caption = paste("The set of both tissues tests tissue and arm together; x axes differ between columns.",
                       "A difference in spread between groups also raises R2 (spread_p in PCA_comparison.csv).")) +
  theme_psmfc(9.5) + theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.title.position = "plot")
save_fig(p5, "PCA_comparison.png", 12, 7)
```

# Outputs

```{r write}
write.csv(cmp, file.path(pca_dir, "PCA_comparison.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
scores <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(sets), function(i) {
  s <- sets[[i]]; sc <- res[[i]]$pca$scores
  data.frame(set = s$id, tissue = ti[s$samples, "tissue"], sample = s$samples, mussel = sub("(F|FX|G)$", "", s$samples),
             group = ti[s$samples, "group"], isolation_date = ti[s$samples, "isolation_date"],
             PC1 = round(sc[s$samples, 1], 4), PC2 = round(sc[s$samples, 2], 4))
}))
scores <- rbind(scores, data.frame(set = "every library", tissue = ti$tissue, sample = rownames(ti),
                                   mussel = sub("(F|FX|G)$", "", rownames(ti)), group = ti$group, isolation_date = ti$isolation_date,
                                   PC1 = round(pa$scores[rownames(ti), 1], 4), PC2 = round(pa$scores[rownames(ti), 2], 4)))
write.csv(scores, file.path(pca_dir, "PCA_scores.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
loadings <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(sets), function(i) do.call(rbind, lapply(1:2, function(k) {
  rot <- res[[i]]$pca$rot; o <- order(abs(rot[, k]), decreasing = TRUE)[1:25]
  nm <- ann$Protein.names[match(rownames(rot)[o], ann$gene)]
  data.frame(set = sets[[i]]$id, component = paste0("PC", k), rank = 1:25, LOC_ID = rownames(rot)[o],
             loading = round(rot[o, k], 4), byssal_name = grepl(BYSSAL_RX, nm, ignore.case = TRUE, perl = TRUE),
             protein_name = nm)
}))))
write.csv(loadings, file.path(pca_dir, "PCA_loadings.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(iso, file.path(pca_dir, "PCA_isolation_day.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(shared, file.path(pca_dir, "isolation_day_contrasts.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
## this step writes no provenance file, so a failed check stops it (and the runner reports it)
cat(sprintf("checks: %d run, %d failed\n", .checks$n_run, length(.checks$failed)))
if (length(.checks$failed)) stop("check failed: ", paste(.checks$failed, collapse = "; "))
cat("sample sets:", length(sets), "| scores:", nrow(scores), "rows\n")
```
